description: This file defines a class 'perf_mssqlnative' for performance monitoring and tuning specific to MS SQL Server, including methods for explaining query plans, retrieving table information, and performing health checks, as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: perf_mssqlnative
classes.description: A class for performance monitoring and tuning specifically tailored for MS SQL Server within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with a database connection, adjusting SQL syntax based on the connection's data provider.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan and performance details for a given SQL statement, optionally partial, by enabling showplan and retrieving diagnostic info from SQL Server.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables in the database along with size and index information.

methods.name: sp_who
methods.description: Returns the current number of active sessions using the 'sp_who' stored procedure.

methods.name: HealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check by enabling and disabling trace flags and calling the parent class's health check method.
